text: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.

change.say: actually, make it widescreen instead of vertical, and keep everything else the same.
